section_summaries.individual_diagnostics: In five of the more than 100 cases of SMS patients whose sera we have tested, autoantibodies are directed against another neuronal protein of 128 kDa identified as amphiphysin All five patients with amphiphysin autoimmunity are women with breast cancer In two of these patients, an infiltrating ductal adenocarcinoma of the breast was found only after the identification of the anti-amphiphysin antibodies
